acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Health-only, empty responses, stale code, generic HTML, foreign-listener replacement, or unverified panel claims may not pass.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: A Codex user opening the Plotkeeper sidebar.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Repeated events and children reuse the stable canonical run without losing history.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Ordinary message IDs or session variants may not create competing root runs or collapse distinct tasks.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: The Plotkeeper scanner and ledger observing live Codex sessions.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The exact 0.1.1 candidate is documented, reviewed, safely releasable, public, installed, and communicated to every reconciled current task.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No stale contract, rollback, candidate, CI, release note, install, task mapping, or generic message may pass.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Repository users and current Plotkeeper-enabled Codex tasks.

stop_conditions: Any empty dashboard response, foreign listener termination, or duplicate canonical enrollment remains reproducible.
Any test, independent review, verifier, guard, push, tag, release, CI, install, live attestation, or task delivery fails.
Any forbidden, unrelated, secret, cache, history, or unexplained diff appears.
A supposed current task cannot be reconciled between the ledger and Codex registry.
known_discrepancies: The initial candidate contract forbade the release-verifier pointer update and retained an obsolete rollback target; this final amendment permits only those required release bindings.
The live listener is still the stale August 7 process pending exact-candidate DEPLOY_READY review.
The historical ledger retains old duplicate rows by design; the patch prevents new pseudo-root duplicates without deleting history.
